## ✨ Highlights

- **New agent: PenguinHarness** — HarnessKit now shows [PenguinHarness](https://github.com/Prism-Shadow/penguin-harness) as its 16th agent, read-only for now: skills from every agent state, plus its `AGENTS.md`, memory files and `system_config.yaml`. MCP servers and hooks are left for a follow-up.
- **Install to agents in bulk** — select several extensions and install them to any number of agents in one run, with an option to overwrite existing copies.
- **Bug fixes** — long hook names no longer stretch the Extensions table or push the detail panel's Close button out of view.
